steps.text: Heat 1 tsp oil. Soften the chopped onion and tomato (4 min).
Add the beaten eggs and a pinch of salt and haldi. Stir until just set.
Make 2 rotis on a hot tawa.
Simmer the oats in the milk for 3 minutes.
Slice the banana on top.
Heat 1 tsp oil; cook onion, capsicum and tomato for 4 minutes.
Crumble in the paneer with salt, haldi and garam masala; cook 2 minutes.
Make 2 rotis.
Pressure-cook the washed dal with haldi for 3 whistles.
Cook the rice.
Tadka: 1 tsp oil, jeera, onion, tomato; pour over the dal.
Cook the rice.
Heat 2 tsp oil — not 3. Brown the onion (6 min).
Add ginger-garlic, tomato and masala; cook until oil separates.
Add the chicken and a little water; simmer 15 minutes.
Serve with rice.
Pressure-cook the soaked rajma until soft.
Cook the rice.
Masala: 1 tsp oil, onion, tomato, ginger-garlic; add rajma and simmer 10 minutes.
Serve with rice.
Pressure-cook the soaked chana.
Masala: 1 tsp oil, onion, tomato, chole masala; add chana, simmer 10 minutes.
Make 2 rotis.
Heat 2 tsp oil, add jeera, onion, then potato and gobi with haldi and salt.
Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes, stirring twice.
Make 2 rotis.
Cook the rice.
Pan-cook the chicken pieces in 1 tsp oil with salt and pepper (8 min).
Bowl: rice, chicken, cucumber, curd on the side.

recipes.name: Curd bowl with banana and peanut butter

steps.text: Curd in a bowl, banana on top, 1 tbsp peanut butter.
Blend 1 scoop whey, 1 glass milk and the banana.
Cook the rice.
Soak the soya chunks in hot water for 10 minutes; squeeze out the water.
Masala: 1 tsp oil, onion, tomato, ginger-garlic; add the chunks and simmer 8 minutes.
Serve with rice.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes.
Toast 2 slices.
